features.name: Tools from outside MCP servers in Sparky chat, with Allow / Deny approvals
features.description: An admin can give Sparky chat the tools of another MCP server (Streamable HTTP, optional bearer token), choosing which of its tools chat may use; this setup is on the web only. Each person turns each server on for their own chat under 'Tools from outside servers', on the web and in the mobile app's AI settings; servers are off by default and never used in a family member's account. Chat now asks through an Allow / Deny card before any delete, and before any change that follows an outside result, on web, iOS and Android; replies that used an outside server get a line to delete that message or clear the chat.

features.name: Client certificate (mTLS) for the server connection
features.description: Import a client certificate (.p12) into the phone app so a reverse proxy that requires mutual TLS lets it in; it is sent only to the saved servers' hostnames. Experimental. SSO and passkey sign-in also need the certificate installed in the phone's settings for the browser. English only. The web uses the browser's own certificate store, nothing in the web app.
